component-o.description-s: 3 A 100 V Schottky barrier rectifier, 850 mV VF max, SOD-123FL

source-o.table-s: Maximum Ratings And Electrical Characteristics, DSK310 column: VRRM 100 V, I(AV) 3.0 A, VF 0.85 V max at 3.0 A, IR 0.3 mA max at 25 C (5.0 mA at 100 C)
source-o.polarity-s: Page 1, Mechanical Data: "Color band denotes cathode end"; the SOD-123FL outline on the same page draws the band at one end. The datasheet does not number the terminals. Pin 1 = cathode is the footprint's numbering (footprints/DSK310.pretty: pad 1 at x = -1.63 mm, silkscreen bar at x = -0.72 mm on the pad-1 side; DSK310.kicad_sym pin 1 = C), so the part's band goes over the silkscreen bar.
source-o.land-pattern-s: Page 3, Suggested Pad Layout: pads 1.2 x 1.2 mm, 3.2 mm centre to centre, 2.0 mm gap, 4.4 mm overall. The footprint's pads are 1.2 x 1.2 mm at 3.26 mm centres.
